title: Java Abstraction
learningObjectives: Explain abstraction as exposing essential behaviour while hiding implementation details.
Declare an abstract class using the abstract keyword.
Recognize that an abstract class cannot be instantiated directly.
Implement inherited abstract methods in a concrete subclass.
Use abstract classes to share state or common behaviour among related types.

understand.concept: Abstraction focuses on what an object can do while leaving implementation details to concrete subclasses. An abstract class can contain fields, constructors, concrete methods and abstract methods. It cannot be instantiated directly.
understand.whyItMatters: Abstraction provides a common contract for related classes while allowing each concrete class to implement details appropriate to its role.
understand.analogy: Think of a well-designed object as a small service with a clear responsibility: it keeps the information it owns and exposes only the operations other code needs.
understand.analogyLimit: This analogy is only a design aid; Java access, inheritance and dispatch follow the language's exact rules.

explain.narrative:
## Abstract classes

Declare an abstract class with `abstract class`. It may contain both implemented methods and abstract method declarations. An abstract method has no body and ends with a semicolon.

## Concrete subclasses

A concrete subclass must implement inherited abstract methods or itself be declared abstract. Create objects from concrete subclasses, not directly from an abstract class.

## When to use

Use an abstract class when related types share state or implementation as well as a common contract. Use an interface when defining a capability that unrelated classes can implement.

## Common mistakes

- Trying to instantiate an abstract class.
- Forgetting to implement an abstract method in a concrete child.
- Declaring an abstract method with a body.

examples.title: Implement an abstract method
examples.explanation: The concrete subclass supplies the abstract method implementation.

examples.title: Abstract class can contain concrete methods
examples.explanation: The subclass inherits the implemented method and provides the abstract one.

examples.title: Share state in an abstract class
examples.explanation: The abstract parent supplies shared state and a constructor.

examples.title: Use an abstract type as a reference
examples.explanation: A reference may use the abstract parent type while pointing to a concrete object.

examples.title: Extend an abstract class with common behaviour
examples.explanation: Concrete and abstract members can coexist in an abstract class.

practise.guidedTask: Create a small Java program about java abstraction. Predict its output, then compile and run it with JDK 21.
practise.independentTask: Build an original program demonstrating java abstraction in a practical scenario. Include at least two test cases, expected outputs and a short explanation of your design choices.
hints: Identify the class, object or type that owns each piece of state or behaviour.
Trace the declared type and runtime object separately when inheritance is involved.
Compile after each small change and compare actual output with your prediction.
practise.challenge: Extend one java abstraction example with a realistic boundary case and explain how the design handles it.

questions.prompt: Can an abstract class be instantiated directly?
options: Only when it has no fields
questions.explanation: Abstract classes are incomplete types intended for extension.

questions.prompt: How is an abstract class declared?
questions.explanation: The abstract modifier appears before class.

questions.prompt: What must a concrete subclass do with inherited abstract methods?
questions.explanation: A concrete class must provide implementations for inherited abstract methods.

questions.prompt: Can an abstract class have a constructor?
questions.explanation: Constructors initialize the parent portion of concrete subclass objects.

questions.prompt: What can an abstract class contain?
questions.explanation: Abstract classes can provide shared state and concrete behaviour.
